content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We’re a growing med spa with two locations and we’re moving everything over from Mindbody and Mailchimp into GoHighLevel. We need an experienced GHL specialist to set up our account properly from the start.

What we need:

A 3-step funnel: landing page with a Botox/filler offer, booking page, and thank you page
Calendar setup for both locations with different staff and service durations
Appointment reminder automations (SMS + email) at 24 hours and 2 hours before
A no-show follow-up workflow to rebook missed appointments
Missed call text-back
Review request automation sent 2 hours after an appointment
Import of around 4,000 existing contacts with tags based on past services
Basic pipeline for tracking new leads through to booked and showed

Requirements:

Proven experience with GHL funnels, workflows, and calendars
Experience with A2P registration is a plus
Must test everything before launch
Good communication and English

Budget: Fixed price, open to bids. Please include your price and timeline.

Timeline: We’d like this live within 2 weeks.

To apply, please answer:

Have you worked with med spas or healthcare businesses before?
How would you handle the contact import so we don’t text people who previously unsubscribed?
Share 1–2 funnels you’ve built in GHL.

Please don’t send a generic proposal. We’ll skip anyone who doesn’t answer the questions.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: GoHighLevel Expert for Med Spa
